data.desc: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. is a technology-driven provider of lifecycle automotive services. Through its online and offline platforms, the Company provides automotive products and services, including vehicle-related services, auto parts and accessories, automotive insurance-related services, maintenance support and other value-added solutions. Leveraging its online supply-chain cloud platform, SaaS capabilities and industry service network, Autozi seeks to improve collaboration and operating efficiency across the automotive value chain.
